facts.business: Jay Ambe Supermarkets Limited operates retail supermarkets across Gujarat, India, and is expanding its store network including a mall property at Chiloda.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure towards acquisition of buildings, furniture, tools and racks, and right-of-use assets for new stores and Chiloda mall property
New Right-of-Use (ROU) assets addition for leased store premises

key_risks: Revenue recognition timing and completeness risk, particularly around year-end
Significant increase in depreciation and financial charges due to capital expenditure and lease additions
Dependence on continued shift from unorganized to organized retail in Gujarat's Tier-II/III towns
